texts: Microdeletion of chromosome 15q is not associated with truncus arteriosus: D.
About a third of patients with truncus have a 22q11 deletion (DiGeorge syndrome), which also brings hypocalcaemia and immune deficiency.
Mutations or inactivation of the transcription factors NKX2.5 and GATA-6, and duplication of chromosome 8p, have also been reported with it.
In the picture, Saint George (22q11), the six-barred gate (GATA-6) and the two octopuses (8p duplication) are let in, and the 15 sign is turned away.
Memory hook: 22 rides in; 15 waits outside.
